title: nav-fleet: operations
description: Health of fleet-gateway, fleet-control, mcp-registry and the MCP servers. Panels follow the alerts in .nais/app.yaml.

list.label: Metrics
list.name: DS_METRICS
list.description: Mimir data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

list.label: Logs
list.name: DS_LOGS
list.description: Loki data source with X-Scope-OrgID tenant. This dashboard belongs in the Grafana that reads the tenant org.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: MCP requests through the gateway.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Red above 10 %, like the alert FleetGatewayHigh5xxRate. Deliberate 503s with a reason are not counted. The alert also needs more than 20 requests in 5 min, so a few requests at night can turn this red without an alert.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", code=~"5..", reason=""}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(fleet_gateway_http_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env"}[5m]))

panels.title: Failed MCP calls/s
panels.description: Failures use the SLO definition: every outcome except ok, unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. user_cap and user_sse_cap count as failures.

panels.title: Latency p95 incl. SSE
panels.description: No latency alert; shown for trend. Includes SSE streams, which count until they close, and fast 401s. Shown as p95 incl. SSE until the gateway has an SSE label.

panels.title: Error ratio (SLO)
panels.description: Share of counted MCP calls that failed, same ratio as the SLO in #2972. Failures use the SLO definition: every outcome except ok, unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. user_cap and user_sse_cap count as failures. Excluded outcomes are left out of the denominator too. Orange from 3 % and red from 7.2 %, the slow and fast burn thresholds for the 99.5 % target (#2972).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route", outcome!~"ok|unauthorized|disabled|tool_denied"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route", outcome!~"unauthorized|disabled|tool_denied"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Available replicas
panels.description: Same metric as the alert FleetGatewayNoReadyPods.

panels.title: Load shedding (5 min)
panels.description: 503s from shedding. The value is the count over the alert's own window (5 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 5 (SustainedShedding).

panels.title: Rate limited (5 min)
panels.description: 429s. The value is the count over the alert's own window (5 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 20 (SustainedRateLimiting).

panels.title: Upstream token errors (10 min)
panels.description: The value is the count over the alert's own window (10 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 5 (UpstreamTokenErrors).

panels.title: Failed MCP calls (5 min)
panels.description: Failures use the SLO definition: every outcome except ok, unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. user_cap and user_sse_cap count as failures.

panels.title: Route sync failures (15 min)
panels.description: Count over the last 15 min, last value. No alert; amber from 1.

panels.title: Never synced pods (dev)
panels.description: Dev gateway pods with no successful route sync from fleet-control yet, like the alert FleetGatewayRouteNeverSynced. Dev only: prod reads routes from git, so the snapshot age gauge never exists there.

targets.expr: count(fleet_gateway_routes_loaded{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name="dev"} unless on (pod, k8s_cluster_name) fleet_gateway_route_snapshot_age_seconds{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name="dev"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Routes disabled (kill switch)
panels.description: Routes that answered with outcome=disabled (503 reason=disabled) in the last 5 min: the kill switch is on. Not a fault.

targets.expr: count(sum by (route) (increase(fleet_gateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route", outcome="disabled"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container restarts (15 min)
panels.description: The value is the count over the alert's own window (15 min), last value, with the alert threshold. The sparkline shows the history. Red above 2 (PodRestarts).

panels.title: 5xx rate (excluding deliberate rejections)
panels.description: Same expression as the alert FleetGatewayHigh5xxRate: 5xx without a reason label. Alerts above 10 %.

panels.title: 5xx by status code
panels.description: 5xx responses the alert counts (no reason label), by status code.

panels.title: Failed MCP calls by route and outcome
panels.description: Failures use the SLO definition: every outcome except ok, unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. user_cap and user_sse_cap count as failures.

panels.title: Available vs desired replicas
panels.description: Alert NoReadyPods fires when a deployment has 0 available replicas.

panels.title: Load shedding by reason
panels.description: 503 with a reason: cap, user_cap, user_sse_cap, store_full, refresh_in_flight, disabled.

panels.title: Rate limited by endpoint
panels.description: Rejected calls (429) by OAuth endpoint.

panels.title: Upstream token errors
panels.description: Alert UpstreamTokenErrors: more than 5 in 10 min.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Alert PodRestarts: more than 2 restarts in 15 min.

panels.title: Route snapshot age (fleet-gateway)
panels.description: Age of each pod's route snapshot. The alert FleetGatewayRouteSnapshotStale fires above 600 s. Pods that never synced are missing here: see Never synced pods.

panels.title: fleet-gateway errors and warnings
panels.description: Error and warning lines from fleet-gateway (tenant Loki).

panels.title: Routes loaded
panels.description: Routes the gateway has loaded from its configuration.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Calls to the MCP gateway by route.

panels.title: Requests by outcome (counted by SLO)
panels.description: Outcomes the SLO counts. Every outcome except ok is a failure; user_cap and user_sse_cap count as failures. Excluded outcomes are in the next panel.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (route, le) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (rate(fleet_gateway_mcp_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 by route incl. SSE
panels.description: MCP call duration by route. Includes SSE streams, which count until they close, and fast 401s. Shown as p95 incl. SSE until the gateway has an SSE label.

panels.title: Routes from stored snapshot
panels.description: 1 means the pod started from a stored snapshot because fleet-control did not answer.

panels.title: Excluded outcomes (not failures)
panels.description: unauthorized (OAuth handshake 401), disabled (kill switch) and tool_denied. The SLO leaves these out.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (path, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-registry"}[$__rate_interval])))

(sum(rate(mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-onboarding", status="error"}[1h])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app="mcp-onboarding"}[1h]))

panels.title: Tool call error rate (1 h)
panels.description: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,status} only exists after the first tool call since the pod started, and status="error" only after a failed call. An empty graph means no calls in range, not missing data.

panels.title: Up by MCP server
panels.description: Scrape target health for the MCP servers.

panels.title: Tool calls: success vs error
panels.description: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,status} only exists after the first tool call since the pod started, and status="error" only after a failed call. An empty graph means no calls in range, not missing data.

panels.title: Tool calls by server and tool
panels.description: mcp-kodeverk, mcp-team-catalog and mcp-dolly, from lib/mcpkit.

targets.expr: sum by (app) (rate(mcp_tool_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app=~"mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog|mcp-dolly"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (app) (rate(mcp_tool_requests_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", app=~"mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog|mcp-dolly"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool call error rate by server
panels.description: Failed calls divided by all calls.

panels.title: HTTP requests by status code
panels.description: Alert High5xxRate for fleet-control.

panels.title: Errors: database, audit, notify
panels.description: Alert DBErrors: more than 5 database errors in 10 min.

panels.title: Console lookups: total and failed
panels.description: Alert ConsoleLookupsFailing: 3 or more failed lookups in 10 min.

panels.title: Last successful snapshot age
panels.description: Alert SnapshotStale above 600 s.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name, msg) (count_over_time({service_namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", service_name=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control"} |= "audit" | json | msg=~"audit .*" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Audit events by service
panels.description: From the stdout log (tenant Loki). Shows volume, not content.

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", container=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control|mcp-registry|mcp-onboarding|mcp-dolly|mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", k8s_cluster_name=~"$env", container=~"fleet-gateway|fleet-control|mcp-registry|mcp-onboarding|mcp-dolly|mcp-kodeverk|mcp-team-catalog", resource="cpu"})
